9be3357befe8: Is there a Gantt chart for Salesforce?
d86c22786b88: Yes. MultiDatePick adds a Gantt view to any Salesforce object with a start date and an end date, set up in a wizard with no code. Tasks group into phases and projects with health and milestones, links move the waiting tasks when one slips, dates and values can be edited right in the chart, and a critical path, slack and planned dates show what can still slip and what cannot.
a56513f2377b: How do I create a Gantt chart in Salesforce without code?
a8794a77e54d: Open the MultiDatePick Setup Wizard, choose the object that holds your tasks and its start and end date fields, and tick Offer the Gantt view on the Views tab. Add the calendar to a Lightning page and paste the Config Name. Phases, projects, percent done, milestones, links and planned dates are optional fields you add when you want them.
70d279d71e82: Can a Salesforce Gantt chart show task dependencies?
e9d928918928: Yes. Link tasks with a Waits on lookup, or with your own link object when a task waits on several others. A link object can also give each link a type (after it ends, when it starts or when it ends) and a lag in working days; a Waits on lookup always means after it ends. Drag a task and every task that waits on it moves too.
2b0ea0bd378e: Can I edit dates directly in a Salesforce Gantt chart?
707f6638295f: Yes. Click or tap a task’s Start, End, Days, Done or Owner, or any field column you added, and a box opens right over the value. A new date follows the same rules as a drag: working days only, and the tasks that wait on it move too, with one Undo for all of it. A value you may not change shows a lock, and if a Salesforce validation rule refuses a change, its own message shows and nothing is saved.
6dc8b47c81e9: Can I move one task without moving the tasks that depend on it?
cdd9a56ba50d: Yes. Press Push on in the Gantt toolbar and it turns to Push off. Until you press it again, a drag or a typed date moves only the task you touch, and any link the move breaks turns red and dashed so you can see what to fix. It changes only your own chart, until you reload the page.
9a6dcb33ba63: Can a Salesforce Gantt chart show all dependency lines at once?
80827bd5e8be: Yes. Turn on Always show link lines in the Setup Wizard and every link between tasks is drawn at all times. Point at a task, or tab to it, and its whole chain lights up while the other links fade.
58956156c397: Can a Salesforce Gantt chart show who is overbooked?
9dbb6d106d78: Yes. Turn on Workload and the Gantt groups its rows by person, with an Hours booked strip for every workday that turns red over that person’s hours and counts their other bookings and time off. A panel suggests a fix for each overbooked person, a bar can be dragged onto someone with room, and Level all lists every change before saving it with one Undo.
da53abe3abdf: Can I resize the columns in the Gantt view?
7cfb289a95fc: Yes. Drag the edge of a column head, the task name column included, or double-click the edge to fit the column to what it shows. Your widths are kept for you on that page in your browser, and Reset column widths puts them back.
e8723d26d761: Does the Gantt view show the critical path?
866f147ee783: Yes. The Critical path button highlights the tasks with no slack, where any delay moves the finish date. Each linked task’s hover card says how many workdays it can slip, and a Slack column can list it for every task.
bd65fbff4565: Can I compare planned dates with actual dates in a Salesforce Gantt chart?
910f327b4799: Yes. Choose two date fields for the planned start and end. Each bar gets a plan bar under it and shows +N days when it slipped, each project shows how many days it is behind plan, and Set baseline saves the current dates as the plan.
82e75616fe6e: Which Salesforce objects can the Gantt view use?
87f49d567f24: Any standard or custom object with a date field for the start and one for the end, such as your own Project Task object. Phases and projects come from fields on the same records (a picklist, a text field or a lookup), and links come from a lookup or your own link object.
e03b0a6e4b50: Does the Gantt view skip weekends and holidays?
983fce353b47: Yes. Skip weekends is on by default, so pushes, lag and day counts skip Saturday and Sunday. Office closures from Blocked Dates and the days a resource is closed are skipped too. Turn Skip weekends off when every day is a working day.
990d5fb8a240: How many tasks can the Gantt view handle?
ce0cb0599c7c: Hundreds. It was measured with 511 tasks and 474 links: the first draw took about 160 milliseconds, and a sort, a collapse or a new horizon about a tenth of a second. A long chart draws only the rows near the screen, so scrolling all 511 tasks never pauses for more than about 0.2 seconds.
c60bb11a60b2: Does the Gantt view cost extra?
16e7e3da38ee: No. It is part of MultiDatePick, $25 per user per month with every feature in one plan and a 30-day free trial. The Gantt view is one of the calendar’s views, turned on per page in the Setup Wizard.
4c1815552c10: What objects do I need for the Gantt chart?
c6b52c21c828: One object with a start date: each record is a bar, one day long when it has no end date. A lookup to a project gives one row per project, and optional fields add the rest: a person for Workload, Waits on for links and the critical path, Phase, Percent done, hours, planned dates for the baseline and a Milestone checkbox. A separate task link object is needed only when a task waits on several.
